content: We established that crowd annotation are still useful in supplementing expert annotations for medical IE. Obtaining expert annotations for the one thousand most difficult instances greatly improved the model performance. However the choice of how many difficult instances to annotate was an uninformed choice. Here we check if less expert data would have yielded similar gains. Future work will need to address how best to choose this parameter for a routing system.
